PR adds a new constructor to `TextLayout` which accepts another `TextLayout` and a `TextRunRenderOverrideProperties` object. This allows the foreground, background, and decorations of the text to be non-destructively overridden.

The use case for this is highlighting specific segments of a `TextLayout`, for example search result hits.

## What is the current behavior?
Rendering properties are currently baked into each text run and cannot be changed after the `TextLayout` has been generated.

## Breaking changes
None.
